exact_request.text: Compact fantasy tactical game sound, dry close recording, clear at low volume, controlled transients and soft high frequencies, centered mono-compatible, no speech, no background music, no environmental ambience, no long reverb. Keep instrument gestures brief when musically themed. Two slim daggers cut a fast close crossing arc, dry cloth motion and focused blade hiss. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.
